rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action, explanation, or piece of speech is not clear.

example.english: I explained it unclearly, so ask me again.
example.traditional: 我解釋得唔清楚，你再問一次啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaai2 sik1 dak1 m4 cing1 co2 nei5 zoi3 man6 jat1 ci3 laa1

rows.note: Use this when someone speaks, answers, or explains in a vague or ambiguous way.

example.english: They answered unclearly and refused to explain properly.
example.traditional: 佢答得含糊，完全唔肯講清楚。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daap3 dak1 ham4 wu4 jyun4 cyun4 m4 hang2 gong2 cing1 co2

rows.jyutping: V dak1 mou4 mou4 wu4 wu4
rows.note: Use this when something is perceived, remembered, or described indistinctly rather than sharply.

example.english: I remember unclearly that it seemed to be raining that day.
example.traditional: 我記得模模糊糊，嗰日好似落緊雨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gei3 dak1 mou4 mou4 wu4 wu4 go2 jat6 hou2 ci5 lok6 gan2 jyu6
